market: CHI −6.5, total 47.5. Caleb 31.5 attempts / 20.5 completions and 4.5 rushes; Mayfield 29.5 / 18.5. Swift 15.5 carries; Irving 15.5; Gainwell 6.5.
lineup: TB WR Emeka Egbuka is questionable (foot), WR Jalen McMillan is out, and LB Yaya Diaby is out. CHI RB Kyle Monangai is questionable, OT Braxton Jones is out, and CBs Tyrique Stevenson and Malik Muhammad are questionable.

keys.how: Rush lanes. TB forces QBs out of the pocket on 14.6% of dropbacks, the fewest of any defense here, and allows 12.6 QB rushing yards a game.
keys.gives: Time to throw. TB blitzes 40.5%, which leaves the middle open for the TE.
keys.counter: Caleb has stayed in the pocket and thrown (305, 308, 247 yards the last three games). Colston Loveland's target share has been 21–40% in that stretch.

keys.take: TB's ground game, which just ran for 310 and 230 yards in two blowout wins (47 and 55 carries).
keys.how: Score. Opponents run only 19.4 times a game against CHI, the fewest here, because they're behind.
keys.gives: CHI allows 4.49 yards per carry, so it doesn't stop the run so much as make teams give up on it.
keys.counter: TB keeps it within one score and splits Irving and Gainwell, as it did in its competitive games.

scripts.control: CHI leads (about 73% to win). TB's runs dry up: in its five losses, Irving had 8–19 carries for 45–89 yards. Caleb throws about 33 times, and Loveland's volume holds.
scripts.competitive: TB runs 25+ times. That's the only script that sinks the Irving under, and it needs TB to be within a score in the fourth quarter.
scripts.reversal: TB leads, Irving gets 24–27 carries like the last two weeks, and Caleb is chasing, when he scrambles more.

plays.why: The last two weeks were blowout wins where TB ran 47 and 55 times. As a 6.5-point road underdog against the defense opponents run on least, he'll get far fewer carries.
plays.support: Opponents run 19.4 times a game against CHI. In TB's five losses, Irving had 8–19 carries for 45, 89, 46, 61 and 46 yards.
plays.sample: 60+ in 2 of 5 TB losses and 3 of 3 TB wins. The spread says loss.
plays.counter: CHI allows 4.49 yards per carry, and he's explosive (170 last week). One long run cashes the Yes.
plays.loses: TB stays within a score and keeps feeding him, or a 50-yard run.
plays.vs: Beat under 50 (No 59¢, needs 61%), which buys only 10 yards of cushion at 15 cents more.

plays.why: Since returning, Caleb has extended plays to throw rather than run, and TB's rush lanes are built to keep QBs in the pocket.
plays.support: Play-by-play: 3, 4 and 1 runs (4, 19 and 2 yards) in his last three starts, with 1–3 scrambles each. TB allows 12.6 QB rushing yards a game and forces QBs out of the pocket on 14.6% of dropbacks, the fewest here.
plays.sample: 20+ in 2 of 5 starts. Both were Weeks 1–2 (65 against CAR, 42 against MIN).
plays.counter: He has the speed, and one blown rush lane is 20 yards. CHI calls some designed runs in the red zone.
plays.loses: TB's blitz (40.5%) gets home and Caleb escapes upfield, or a red-zone keeper.
plays.vs: Beat under 25 (No 63¢, needs 65%), which is priced past our estimate.

plays.why: With Caleb back, the TE has become a primary read, and TB's blitz leaves the middle open.
plays.support: Loveland's target share: 21%, 40% and 26% in Caleb's last three starts. TB allows 8.1 TE targets a game.
plays.sample: 6+ catches in 3 of 3 Caleb starts since Week 6 (6, 7, 7). 4 of 8 overall.
plays.counter: Burden and Odunze are both producing, and CHI's lead script trims Caleb to 30–33 attempts.
plays.loses: CHI leads big early and Caleb throws 25 times, or Burden is the hot read.
plays.vs: Preferred over 50+ yards (56¢). The catch floor comes from the role, while the yards depend on run-after-catch.

passed.name: D'Andre Swift 60+ rush (55¢)
passed.why: The CHI lead script helps, but TB allows 3.81 yards per carry and Monangai (questionable) would split if active.

passed.name: Baker Mayfield yards
passed.why: His last two starts (3 and 11 attempts) don't predict a game where TB trails.
